file_purpose: Audit, FOI evidence and gap-tracking profile for Edinburgh A100. This file records official Edinburgh evidence, FOI-derived formula rules, historical statistics, unresolved gaps and integration policy.

metadata.notes: Updated with the official universal 20-point academic ceiling, corrected IB 6 + 14 final-score structure, and FOI-attributed SJT Band 1–3 points. Home, Scottish and Rest of UK eligibility and international pool logic remain unchanged.

readiness.summary: Edinburgh A100 supports eligibility checks, verified international historical UCAT guidance and separate international pre-interview ranking out of 40. Assessment Day final-score calculation is retained only as an optional research utility.

a_level.standard: AAA in one sitting, including Chemistry and one from Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics/Further Mathematics or Physics.
a_level.widening_access: AAB in one sitting for eligible widening access Plus Flag applicants.
a_level.gcse_dependency: Standard GCSE Biology, Chemistry, English and Mathematics at A/7; widening access minimum B/6.

sqa.standard: AAAAB by end of S5 and BB at Advanced Higher in S6.
sqa.widening_access: AAABB by end of S5 and CC at Advanced Higher in S6.
sqa.required_subjects: Higher Chemistry plus two from Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics/Applications of Mathematics or Physics.
sqa.national_5: Biology, Chemistry, English and Mathematics at B. Higher Applications of Mathematics at C may replace National 5 Mathematics at B.

ib.standard: 38 points with 666 at Higher Level, including Chemistry and one from Biology, Mathematics or Physics.
ib.standard_level_requirements: Mathematics, English and Biology if not at Higher Level are required at the published standard/widening grades.

graduate_policy.minimum: UK 2:1 honours degree or international equivalent.
graduate_policy.non_science_condition: Non-science graduates also require SQA Higher, A level, or equivalent, in Chemistry at B.

resit_policy.summary: All examination grades must be obtained at first attempt. Resit qualifications are not entered into selection except in very exceptional circumstances with verified evidence before UCAS application.

ucat_sjt_policy.ucat_ranking_method: Scores are ranked, divided into deciles and allocated a score.
ucat_sjt_policy.sjt_public_page_scope: Confirms 7.5% contribution and Band 4 automatic rejection, but not exact Band 1–3 values.
ucat_sjt_policy.exemption_policy: UCAT exemptions only in very exceptional circumstances with prior agreement; exempt applicants receive average UCAT score and SJT banding for their fee-status group.
ucat_sjt_policy.deadline_conflict: Degree Finder states 15 July 2026; UCAT page states 1 August in the year of application.

contextual_policy.plus_flag: Considered with any UCAT total score and receives 10% UCAT uplift.
contextual_policy.ucat_bursary: Receives same concessions as Plus Flag applicants.
contextual_policy.flag: Must meet cutoff and receives 5% UCAT uplift.
contextual_policy.simd40: Scottish-domiciled applicants in the second lowest SIMD40 quintile must meet cutoff and receive 10% UCAT uplift.
contextual_policy.band_4_override: No applicant with SJT Band 4 is considered, regardless of contextual eligibility.

interview_format.format: Assessment half-day with a series of short interviews.
interview_format.delivery: Scottish and RUK/RoI fee-rate candidates are required to attend in person; Degree Finder also refers to assessment day at Edinburgh Medical School or online.
interview_format.assessment_basis: Medical Schools Council core attributes required of doctors.

historical_2025_admissions_statistics.use_policy: Historical context only. Do not use as current prediction cutoffs.

pre_interview_score.formula: Academic score out of 20 + UCAT cognitive score out of 14 + SJT score out of 6
pre_interview_score.notes: International applicants are ranked by the total pre-interview score, not by UCAT alone.

ucat_policy.notes: The verified 1650 value is the 2026 eligibility threshold. It is not a fixed interview cut-off, and no fixed international interview boundary is published.

sjt_policy.public_source_note: The public University page confirms SJT contributes 7.5% and Band 4 is automatically rejected, but does not publish the exact Band 1–3 values.

ib.notes: The component total is already the final doubled score out of 20. The IB minimum entry requirement is separate and must never be used as an academic-score input.

final_total.formula: Pre-interview score out of 40 + Assessment Day/MMI score out of 40

bands.recommendation: Not eligible / automatic rejection due to minimum UCAT threshold

historical_ucat_guidance_2700.disclaimer: Historical international UCAT competitiveness guidance only. Edinburgh ranks by total pre-interview score out of 40, not UCAT alone, and publishes no fixed interview cut-off.

international_selection_evidence.notes: Verified international evidence only. Do not apply this branch to Home, Scottish or Rest of UK applicants.

ib.entry_requirement_example_not_a_score: IB 37 points is a minimum entry requirement and is not an input to the academic scoring calculation.

academic_score_ceiling_evidence.notes: Official scoring tables confirm the same 20-point final academic ceiling for A Level, Scottish, IB and recognised international qualification routes.

unresolved_gaps.description: FOI-derived evidence confirms post-interview score is out of 50 and reports Assessment Day structure/domains, but exact station marking scheme is not supplied.
FOI-derived evidence confirms UCAT subtest use as tie-break metadata, but not the exact sequence/order of tie-break application.
Plus Flag and SIMD40 UCAT policies are partly represented, but full handling for Flag, UCAT bursary, care-experienced, refugee and asylum seeker applicants remains incomplete.
The current evidence stores UCAT uplift percentages but does not explicitly confirm whether uplift is applied before or after fee-cohort decile ranking.
Degree Finder gives 15 July 2026; UCAT page gives 1 August in the year of application.
BTEC, Access to HE, T-Level and other non-standard qualification rules were not verified in Step 1 official evidence or the FOI formula package.

foi_sources.notes: Use only FOI/official rules and historical statistics from the package as Edinburgh evidence. Exact SJT points are FOI-confirmed: Band 1 = 6.0, Band 2 = 4.5, Band 3 = 3.0 and Band 4 = 0.0. Predictor metadata remains ApplySmart-only.

foi_request_targets.question: Please provide the exact station marking scheme/rubric used to convert Assessment Day station/domain marks into the interview score out of 50.
Please provide the exact tie-break order/sequence, including how UCAT subtest scores are ordered and whether additional tie-breakers are applied.
Please clarify full formula handling for Flag, UCAT bursary, care-experienced, refugee and asylum seeker applicants, including whether UCAT uplift is applied before or after decile ranking.
Please confirm BTEC, Access to HE and T-Level acceptance and grade/subject requirements for Edinburgh A100.
Please clarify whether the UCAT exemption deadline should be encoded as 15 July 2026 or 1 August in the application year.
